# Leadmap AI

> Leadmap AI is a Swedish-speaking AI receptionist that answers calls, qualifies leads, and sends qualified booking requests to high-value service businesses (plumbers, roofers, dentists, clinics, car detailers).

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Leadmap AI is, how it works, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Leadmap AI handles call recordings, transcripts and contact details under GDPR.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Terms governing use of Leadmap AI services and the pilot program.
